---
title: Diagramming syntax
---

If you have saved an analysis from a marimo notebook or a command-line script, you can use the open-source `graphviz` application to diagram the analysis. The command-line script `analysis_to_dot.py` creates a graph in the `dot` format used by `graphviz`.

## Prerequisite: `graphviz`

> *ADD NOTE ON INSTALL*

## Diagramming syntax

Create a `dot` file:

```bash
python3 analysis_to_dot.py ANALYSIS_FILE.cex > ANALYSIS.dot
```



Directly create a `.png` file using `dot`

```bash
python3 analysis_to_dot.py analysis_file.cex | dot -Tpng  > analysis_diagram.png
```
